{{Quote|Desire. Keeps people alive who should be long dead.|Soleks|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Soleks''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Soleks was tasked with placing navigational beacons around a [[Big Sink|volcanic sinkhole]] located in the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] in the [[Clabburn Tundra]]. Upon arrival, however, Soleks realized the area surrounding the sinkhole was a [[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]] hunting ground. He then asked an Imperial hero to place the beacons around it to alert any Imperial troops to stay away.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Engineer Soleks appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is featured in "Eyes on the Enemy," a quest that requires the player to place navigation beacons around the Big Sink on the planet Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
